verdict.rationale: A hands-on customer report says Datadog correlates APM, custom metrics and logs via tagging and densely links them across the platform, which supports pivoting from traces to logs and metrics. However, the APM and Log Management docs in the pack are only titles and do not describe a span-level jump to correlated logs and metrics. One critic calls the correlation awful, but that is a general comparison about anomaly surfacing, not a concrete failure, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of span-to-logs and span-to-metrics navigation, evidence of span-level (not just tag-level) linking, and independent hands-on walkthroughs of debugging a request end to end.

support.subject: As a developer, I can jump from a trace span to its correlated logs and metrics to debug a request end to end

citations.quote: Datadog's main advantage is correlating data across APM, custom metrics and logs via tagging, densely linked across the platform
